intro: The Rune-Inscribed Pendant is a magical trinket recovered from Dalaran supply shipments destined for Ambermill. Prized by the Kirin Tor, these pendants serve as conduits for channeling potent arcane energies.

p: Discovered among crates of cartographic supplies bound for the Dalaran enclave at Ambermill, this pendant bears intricate arcane inscriptions. High-ranking wizards of the Kirin Tor frequently employ such artifacts to focus and amplify their spellcasting. The presence of numerous channeled pendants moving into the region immediately draws the suspicion of the Forsaken at the Sepulcher, signaling an impending project of immense magical power.
